tool_args.rationale: The pilot already matches the target horizon, but its largest sink gradient is 2.44, below the proposed onset range of 2.50–2.68. The high-gradient probe is the least expensive measurement aimed at distinguishing a threshold penalty from smooth saturation or inhibition.

considered_alternatives.option: Immediate fit of the threshold avalanche model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations lie below the proposed threshold range, so the fit cannot identify either the threshold or the penalty strength.
The pilot varies input and sink gradient together, so its concavity does not distinguish smooth input dependence from a gradient threshold that has not yet been crossed.
It costs more and is less directly targeted at crossing the proposed sink-gradient threshold.
